## Evaluation Notes

**Source key facts:** Regulation 453/2008 (23 April 2008, OJ L 145, 4.6.2008); legal basis Art. 285(1) TEC / procedure Art. 251; quarterly job vacancy data to Eurostat for units with 1+ employees; NACE coverage with households/extraterritorial bodies excluded, agriculture optional, personal care optional; certain sectors and <10-employee units subject to feasibility studies; seasonal adjustment mandatory; occupied-post data mandatory; back data (4 quarters); quality dimensions; financing for first 3 years ("may receive"); Statistical Programme Committee; implementation report by Commission by 24 June 2010; entry into force 20 days after publication (i.e., 24 June 2008).

**Summary A:** Near-complete restructuring of the full act. Highly informative, but mischaracterizes Art. 1(3) (presents feasibility-study sectors as included), inserts a quality clause under Art. 1 that isn't there, and wrongly describes Art. 9's three-month period as "for implementation reports." Excessively long (full preamble, signature block) — barely a summary.

**Summary B:** Accurate, well-organized, covers scope, key obligations (seasonal adjustment, occupied posts, back data, feasibility studies, publication), full definitions, entry into force. Minor imprecision: cites Art. 251 (procedure) rather than Art. 285(1) as legal basis. Omits financing and quality dimensions.

**Summary C:** Multiple factual errors: entry into force "20 April 2008" (impossible — before adoption); report "submitted by the European Parliament and Council" (it's the Commission); occupied posts/metadata called "optional" (mandatory); "require" Community contributions ("may receive"). "Entry into Force" section repeated three times.

**Summary D:** Title only. Accurate but conveys essentially nothing.

**Summary E:** Readable and tight, but entry into force "20th April 2008" is wrong; "the Commission is tasked with producing the statistics" is wrong (Member States produce); presents feasibility-study/optional sectors as required.

**Summary F:** Fully faithful, correct legal basis, thorough scope and definitions, but omits Art. 3 obligations (seasonal adjustment, occupied posts), feasibility studies, financing, and quality dimensions; the references list is padding.

**Summary G:** Accessible EUR-Lex-style summary with correct application date (24 June 2008) and useful context, but claims reference dates are set by the "European Statistical System Committee" (source: Statistical Programme Committee — anachronistic), and "since 2010"/"70 days" are unverifiable from the source; minor formatting glitches.
